help: Choose what to copy. The original stays unchanged.
taskReset: New tasks start in To do. Comments, history, dependencies and recorded work are not copied.
includeSettings: Copy section summaries and planning checks
settingsPermission: Only owners and administrators can copy section settings.
customFieldsHelp: Fields start empty unless selected. Copied values, including actual hours, can affect reports.
noFields: No custom fields in this project.
previewFailed: The copy could not be checked. Review the options and try again.
sharedReferences: People, periods and manual availability overrides keep their current selections.
checkingAccess: Editing is paused while your current access is checked.
otherSave: Wait for the current save to finish before duplicating.
closeHeld: This copy has not been confirmed. Retry the same copy before closing.

errors.permission: You do not have permission to duplicate this selection. Ask an owner or administrator.
errors.sourceUnavailable: The original is unavailable or no longer visible. Close this dialog and reopen it from the project.
errors.stale: The original changed. Refresh the preview before duplicating.
errors.lockedField: A selected field is locked. Deselect it or ask an administrator to change its rules.
errors.meeting: Meetings and their shared work cannot be duplicated as ordinary tasks. For a section, turn off Copy tasks or choose a section without meetings.
errors.linked: Linked tasks cannot be copied here. Open a task in its home project, or choose a section without linked tasks.
errors.limit: A copy can contain at most 100 tasks. Turn off Subtasks, copy a smaller section, or turn off Copy tasks.
errors.projectLimit: This project is too large to check safely for duplication. Choose a smaller project.
errors.fieldUnavailable: A selected custom field is no longer available. Deselect it and refresh the preview.
errors.attachmentStorage: File storage is unavailable. Ask an administrator to configure it before copying tasks with attachments.
errors.todoMissing: This project needs an active To do status before tasks can be duplicated. Ask an administrator to add one.
errors.archived: Archived tasks and sections cannot be duplicated. Restore the original first.
errors.hierarchy: This task hierarchy cannot be copied safely. Try without subtasks or review the original hierarchy.
errors.sectionOrder: There is no room to add another section at this position. Change the section order and try again.
